positions.name: DeriveIdTestAcceptanceCriteria
positions.frame: what must this reproduction test guarantee for the missing-id failure to count as fixed?
positions.why: src-1 asserts what the test case reproduces (the prod missing-id failure pattern, ## heading with no id field) and src-2 states the required outcome for that same test case (no crash, valid slug). Read together they describe one test's setup-and-acceptance pair rather than two independent claims — the conviction reads differ (src-1 a flat 'claim', src-2 a settled 'decision', per the directional observations) but both orbit the same test artifact, so the tension between describing-what-is and mandating-what-must-be is held within the frame rather than resolved.

placements.why: Both segments describe test-case construction and acceptance criteria for the derive-id pipeline — evidentiary/validation work, not opportunity framing, strategy, product definition, or architecture. Nothing exists yet in this repo's strata; 'Proof' is the org's canonical category for this kind of content and nothing here calls for inventing a different one.
placements.title: Validation work — proving the pipeline holds under real-world failure conditions
placements.frame: Does this content establish or exercise evidence that the system behaves correctly under conditions drawn from production, rather than describing what to build or why?

placements.title: Test cases are grounded in reproduced production failures, not invented scenarios
placements.frame: Does this expression tie a test case's setup to an actual, named failure pattern observed in production, rather than a synthetic or hypothetical one?
placements.why: src-1 asserts that the test reproduces a specific, named prod failure pattern (## heading with no id field) — a methodology of grounding test fixtures in real production failures. This is a recurring practice future envelopes about this pipeline (and others) will keep instantiating, not a one-time fact about a single test run, so it clears the narrative grain test. No existing leaf or strata (both empty) covers this theme, so it is minted standalone under the newly-minted Proof strata.

placements.title: Pipeline correctness is defined by never crashing and always producing valid output, not merely by correct output
placements.frame: Does this expression treat crash-avoidance and always-valid output as a mandatory, non-negotiable invariant for the pipeline, rather than a best-effort goal?
placements.why: src-2 states an operational requirement — 'must not crash; must produce a valid slug' — as a settled, unhedged constraint (per the conviction read: 'decision', not a debated claim). This is a robustness invariant likely to recur as an acceptance bar across future derive-id and related pipeline work, distinct from the failure-reproduction theme of src-1, so it clears the grain test as its own theme rather than folding into the reproduction leaf.
